name: Valentina Quispe Mendoza
bio:
Valentina's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in Human Resources, she took a role at a local logistics firm which just so happened to be supporting the Dakar Rally's South American leg. Intrigued by the passion and dedication of the teams, she quickly became immersed in the world of racing. Seeing the intense pressure on the support staff, she recognized the need for strong HR management to maintain team morale and efficiency.

Determined to make a difference, Valentina honed her skills in talent acquisition, conflict resolution, and team building. Her approach to HR is centered on fostering a supportive and inclusive environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. She believes that a happy and motivated team is a winning team. At 23XI Racing, she's known for her proactive approach to employee well-being and her ability to identify and nurture promising talent.

Valentina's distinctive approach lies in her understanding of the unique challenges faced by motorsport professionals. She brings a blend of empathy, strong organizational skills, and a relentless drive to create a high-performance culture that prioritizes both individual growth and collective success. She is seen as an asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a high ponytail.
physical.description: Valentina is of average height with a strong build and radiant smile that puts others at ease.
